blocks.text: Polymers aise solid materials hain jin ki structure tarteeb (order) aur disorder (be-tarteeb hona) ke beech mein hoti hai; inhen partially (kuch had tak) ya poorly (kam) crystalline solids kehte hain. Polymers natural aur insaan ke banaye (synthetic) materials ka bara group hain. Plastics aur synthetic rubbers ko polymers is liye kehte hain ke yeh polymerization reactions se bante hain: in reactions mein chhote saade molecules chemical taur par jur kar bohat lambi zanjeer (long chain) wale molecules ya teen-dimensional (3D) structures banate hain. In materials ki specific gravity (pani ke muqable density) halki se halki metal se bhi kam hoti hai, phir bhi in ki strength-to-weight ratio (wazan ke hisaab se strength) achhi hoti hai.

Polymers poore ya kuch hisse mein carbon ke oxygen, hydrogen, nitrogen aur doosre metallic ya non-metallic elements ke saath chemical combination (milap) se bante hain. Polythene, polystyrene aur nylon polymers ki misalein hain. Pure (khalis) natural rubber poora ek hydrocarbon hai jis ka formula (C₅H₈)ₙ hai.

blocks.alt: PVC zanjeer (chain) ke ek hisse ka ball-and-stick drawing: chaar carbon atoms (C) zigzag mein, dono siron par bond aage jate hain. Pehle aur teesre carbon par do do hydrogen atoms (H); doosre aur chauthe par ek hydrogen aur ek chlorine atom (Cl).

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa polymer hai: wool (oon), glass, sodium chloride ya copper? Glass ka fixed melting point kyun nahi jabke quartz ka hai?
blocks.explanation: Wool ek natural protein polymer hai; glass amorphous hai, sodium chloride aur copper crystalline hain. Quartz ki lambe faasle tak ki tarteeb ek khaas temperature par achanak toot jati hai, is liye us ka fixed melting point hai. Glass ki be-tarteeb structure garmi se aahista aahista dheeli hoti hai, is liye woh ek range mein naram hota hai aur phir behne lagta hai.

items: Crystalline: regular, lambe faasle tak tarteeb (XRD, TEM se dekhi jati hai); atoms fixed points ke gird vibrate karte hain; fixed melting point (quartz, calcite, cheeni, mica, heera).
Amorphous (glassy): disorder jami hui; koi fixed melting point nahi; aahista naram hota hai (glass, plastic, fused silica).
Polymeric: tarteeb aur disorder ke beech; polymerization se lambi zanjeerein; kam specific gravity magar achhi strength (polythene, polystyrene, nylon, PVC, rubber (C₅H₈)ₙ).
